_comment: Gate replay 9 (M5, J-6): the runtime bus-volume control surface (AudioSystem#set_bus_volume — game-two menu API, mail done/from-game-two-j6-volume-api.md). Choreography: music (stem_a 400 Hz, music bus) runs throughout; drone_low (500 Hz, sfx bus) starts tick 5. Tick 20: sfx trim -20 dB (500 Hz amp must drop to 0.1x while 400 Hz is UNTOUCHED — trim hits only its bus). Tick 40: sfx trim +6.0 must CLAMP to the 0.0 ceiling (exact recovery to authored level; an unclamped +6 would read ~2.0x and break the ratio bound). Tick 60: master trim -60.0 = the floor = gain snaps to exactly 0.0 (quick-mute contract) — true digital silence. Tick 80: master back to 0.0, music recovers to its pre-mute level. group_fade_at count 0 pins duck independence at the log level: the volume path must NEVER touch the group fader. Volume ops apply after update(tick), before that tick's render advance, so effects start exactly at tick*800.
name: replay_bus_volume

ratio._bus_isolation: music 400 Hz must be untouched while the sfx trim is down

ratio._ceiling_clamp: +6.0 request clamps to trim 0.0 = exact authored level; unclamped would be ~2.0

ratio._master_restore: music recovers to its pre-mute level after the mute lifts

silence._master_floor_is_true_mute: gain snaps to exactly 0.0 at the -60 floor

log._runtime_sfx_trims: boot lines sit at frame 0; from_tick 1 isolates the runtime pair

log._duck_independence: the volume path must never touch the group fader

peak._comment: headroom policy: whole render under -1 dBFS sample peak
